Subject: Final CALL FOR ABSTRACTS – SNASforum 2026
Preview: Dear Students, ---------------------------------------------------------------------- NUS Science students (Undergrad, Postgrad & PhD) are eligible for a 50% discount * for the Full 4-Day Pass of this event, sponsored by the NUS Faculty of Science. Students will need to provide their matriculation number and use the Promo Code NUSSci50 when registering. *Limited seats available, discount will be applied on a first-come, first-served basis. ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Join scientists, clinicians, researchers, industry partners, policymakers, and students from Singapore and around the world at SNASforum 2026, an international multidisciplinary conference dedicated to advancing healthcare innovation and translational medicine. 🧬 Theme: Integrating Basic Science into the Future of Health Organised by the Singapore National Academy of Science (SNAS) in conjunction with its 50th Anniversary, SNASforum 2026 will provide a premier platform for the exchange of ideas, presentation of cutting-edge research, and fostering collaborations across academia, healthcare, and industry. Conference Symposia Advanced Materials for Healthcare Applications and Technologies (AMHAT) X 3 Human and Planetary Health (X3HPH) Stem Cells and Regenerative Therapy in Translational Medicine (SCRTTM) 📅 Important Dates 🔹 Abstract Submission Deadline: 30 Sep 2026 🔹 Early Bird Registration Deadline: 30 Sep 2026 🔹 Conference Dates: 7–10 December 2026 📍 Venue National University of Singapore (NUS), Faculty of Science Singapore 📄 Selected abstracts will be featured as oral or poster presentations, providing opportunities to showcase innovative research and engage with leading experts in the field. 🔗 For abstract submission and conference information: www.snasforum.org.sg Join us as we celebrate 50 years of scientific excellence and explore how fundamental scientific discoveries can shape the future of health and medicine. Best Regards, Xu Anyi Senior Executive, SNAS Secretariat snas.org.sg | xu.anyi@snas.org.sg ( E )

We ask that all FoS PG students carefully review the attached document and familiarise themselves with the updated requirements before using the room. The FoS Graduate Student Group Activity Room is a shared community space intended to support events, workshops, meetings, and group discussions. Respecting the facilities, fellow users, and the established guidelines helps ensure the room remains a safe, conducive, and sustainable environment for everyone. Please note that students found to be in violation of these Rules and Guidelines or the NUS Student Code of Conduct may have their room usage privileges suspended or revoked. We appreciate your cooperation and commitment to being considerate users of this shared space. Thank you.
